extracted.intended_audience: SBIR/STTR applicants and institutional grant administrators (PD/PIs, business officers) preparing NIH STTR/SBIR applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting an NIH STTR (Phase I) grant application (PA-16-303) including required biographical sketches, Research & Related budget, SBIR/STTR eligibility questions, human/animal assurances, and Research Plan attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch length and format
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Name, eRA Commons user name, Position Title, EDUCATION/TRAINING (institution, degree, completion date, field). Follow the formats and instructions given; the Biographical Sketch may not exceed five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch - Required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Biographical Sketch must include: A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors; C. Contribution to Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each person, provide a Personal Statement (A), list positions and honors in chronological order (B), and describe contributions to science with representative citations (C).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Senior/Key Person details
rubrics_metrics.description: Section A requires listing Senior/Key Person entries with Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete personnel budget data for each senior/key person in the specified fields; totals for all Senior/Key Persons must be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Equipment threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: Section C. Equipment Description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any equipment item with cost > $5,000 must be itemized with dollar amount; include total funds requested for all equipment and any additional equipment attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget - Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Section F. Other Direct Costs must report amounts for: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; 8. Travel to one national meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out other direct cost line items in the categories provided and include totals; provide justification in the Budget Justification attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification - single file attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: K. Budget Justification: File Name: (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine all budget justification narrative into a single file and attach; do not upload multiple separate budget justification files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs - type, rate, base and negotiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Section H. Indirect Costs: report Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the organization's negotiated indirect cost rate where applicable; for small business STTR applicants the example shows a 40% indirect rate used pending negotiation with NIH (NIH Grants Policy Statement 18.5.4.3.1). Cognizant Federal Agency and POC should be listed for negotiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/contractual F&A exclusion for direct cost limits
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH policy (NOT-OD-05-004) allows applicants to exclude consortium/contractual F&A costs when determining if an application falls at or beneath any applicable direct cost limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an FOA specifies a direct cost limit, applicants may use the policy to determine whether their application meets the limit by excluding consortium/contractual F&A from the direct cost calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct and Indirect Costs reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections I and J require calculation and reporting of Total Direct and Indirect Costs (Funds Requested) and Fee (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative totals for direct costs (A–F), indirect costs (H), and the sum (G+H); include any fee requested in Section J.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR form - Program type and phase selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Type (select only one): SBIR, STTR, or Both. SBIR/STTR Type (select only one): Phase I, Phase II, Fast-Track.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the correct program and phase according to agency-specific instructions; questions 1–7 must be completed by all SBIR/STTR applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR eligibility certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 1a: Do you certify that at the time of award your organization will meet the eligibility criteria for a small business as defined in the funding opportunity announcement? (Yes/No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant must certify small business size/status eligibility at time of award; include anticipated number of personnel (Question 1b).

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR - subcontracts with federal laboratories disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 2: Does this application include subcontracts with Federal laboratories or any other Federal Government agencies? If yes, insert the names of the Federal laboratories/agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose any subcontracting to federal labs/agencies; upload explanation or names as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR - U.S. performance of R&D requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 4: Will all research and development on the project be performed in its entirety in the United States? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'No,' provide an explanation as an attached file; SBIR/STTR mechanisms generally require U.S. performance of R&D unless the FOA allows otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR - prior/parallel proposals disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 5: Has the applicant and/or PD/PI submitted proposals for essentially equivalent work under other Federal program solicitations or received other Federal awards for essentially equivalent work? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes,' identify the other Federal agencies and provide details as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR - Disclosure Permission Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 6: If this application does not result in an award, is the Government permitted to disclose the title of your proposed project and contact information to organizations that may be interested in contacting you for further information? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must indicate whether they permit such disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan requirement for Phase II / Fast-Track
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 7: Commercialization Plan: If submitting a Phase II or Phase I/Phase II Fast-Track Application, include a Commercialization Plan in accordance with the agency announcement and/or agency-specific instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the commercialization plan file when required for Phase II or Fast-Track submissions; follow agency formatting instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR-specific PD/PI employment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: SBIR Question 9: Will the Project Director/Principal Investigator have his/her primary employment with the small business at the time of award? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer per agency-specific rules for SBIR; primary employment with the small business may be required depending on the agency and phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR PD/PI appointment and effort requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: STTR Question 10: PD/PI must have a formal appointment or commitment either with the small business OR as an employee of the Research Institution (which commits to the small business), AND will the PD/PI devote at least 10% effort to the proposed project? (Both must be TRUE for Yes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For STTR applications, the PD/PI must meet the appointment/commitment condition and commit ≥10% effort; indicate Yes/No accordingly and attach supporting documentation if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR division of work percentage requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: STTR Question 11: In the joint research and development proposed, the small business must perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution must perform at least 30% of the work. (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the project work distribution to meet these minimum percent efforts for STTR eligibility and document percentages in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement - Human Subjects and Clinical Trial declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Human Subjects Section: Clinical Trial? (Yes/No). 1a. Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare whether the project involves human subjects or clinical trials; follow the Human Subjects sections and provide Protection of Human Subjects, Data Safety Monitoring Plan, and related attachments if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement - Vertebrate Animals requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: 2. Vertebrate Animals Section: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? (Yes/No). If 'Yes', is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? (Yes/No). If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report use of vertebrate animals and euthanasia methods; if deviating from AVMA guidelines, provide justification and protocol details in the Vertebrate Animals attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement - Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: 3. Program Income Section: Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? (Yes/No). If 'Yes', use the format to reflect amount and source(s) by Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report anticipated program income amounts and sources by budget period when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement - Human Embryonic Stem Cells
rubrics_metrics.description: 4. Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? (Yes/No). If yes, list registration numbers of specific cell lines or indicate that one from the NIH registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers for hESC lines or indicate intent to use a registry-listed line as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement - Inventions and Patents disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: 5. Inventions and Patents Section (RENEWAL): Inventions and Patents: (Yes/No). If 'Yes', answer follow-up questions about previously reported inventions/patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose prior inventions and patents related to the project and answer any renewal-specific questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Research Plan - Required sections list
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Research Plan must include: 1. Introduction (for Resubmission and Revision), 2. Specific Aims, 3. Research Strategy, 4. Progress Report Publication List, 5. Protection of Human Subjects, 6. Data Safety Monitoring Plan, 7. Inclusion of Women and Minorities, 8. Inclusion of Children, 9. Vertebrate Animals, 10. Select Agent Research, 11. Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, 12. Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, 13. Letters of Support, 14. Resource Sharing Plan(s), 15. Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, 16. Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include separate attachments/files for each required Research Plan section (e.g., Specific_Aims, Research_Strategy, VertebrateAnimals, Resource_Sharing). Ensure all required sections are present and follow PHS 398 formatting instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims - content expectations (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims document must state the project's Significance and clear, measurable goals for the proposed phase (examples shown: establish lead candidate peptide by determining impact on glucose tolerance testing, duration of protection, impact on insulin and c-peptide).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write Specific Aims that concisely state significance, translational impact, and phase-appropriate measurable objectives (Phase I: lead candidate establishment; Phase II: mechanism, immunogenicity, PK/toxicity, IND preparation).
